title: Measuring Concept Content in Text from LLM Activations: ESG Evidence from Concept Vectors and Linear Probes
abstract: arXiv:2608.07208v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent work shows that Large Language Models (LLMs) encode more information in their activations than they show in their responses. We ask whether the information contained in activations could be used as a source of measurement for the presence of concepts. We compare two algorithms for extraction of concepts, i.e., Recursive Feature Machine (RFM) algorithm and linear probing against an embedding baseline, surface baselines, and the model's own response using a human-annotated Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) dataset of financial texts. The best linear probe ranges from 0.6 to 3.3 percentage points below fine-tuned domain classifiers. The probes also outscore the model's own response in all comparisons. translated_title: 从大语言模型激活中测量文本的概念内容：基于概念向量与线性探针的ESG证据
translated_abstract: 近期研究表明，大语言模型（LLM）在其激活中编码的信息多于其在响应中所表现出的信息。我们探讨激活中所包含的信息能否作为测量文本中概念存在性的来源。我们在一个人工标注的金融文本环境、社会与治理（ESG）数据集上，比较了两种概念提取算法——递归特征机（RFM）算法和线性探测，并与嵌入基线、表面基线以及模型自身的响应进行对比。最佳线性探针的性能仅比微调的领域分类器低0.6至3.3个百分点。在所有比较中，线性探针的得分均高于模型自身的响应。此外，在所有准确率比较中，线性探针均优于RFM概念向量。在一个合成混合测试中，其平均池化得分在追踪段落中概念句子数量方面优于概念向量（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究证明LLM激活中蕴含的信息可用于测量文本中的概念内容，线性探针在ESG金融文本概念检测上性能接近微调领域分类器，且在所有比较中均优于RFM概念向量和模型自身的文本响应。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates that information in LLM activations can serve as a measurement source for concept presence in text, with linear probes achieving performance close to fine-tuned domain classifiers on ESG financial texts and outperforming both RFM concept vectors and the model's own responses in all comparisons.
